about: Reference values for quantstats' documented estimators, from vetted (https://github.com/WatchTree-19/vetted). Each metric names the convention and, where R PerformanceAnalytics implements it, the R call that reproduces the value to 1e-10. The others are checked in vetted against numpy, scipy or a brute-force definition. bacon_monthly is the 24-month portfolio from Bacon (2008), Practical Portfolio Performance Measurement and Attribution. Signs are as quantstats reports them.

max_drawdown.definition: compounded wealth, starting capital counts as a peak

skewness.definition: adjusted Fisher-Pearson G1 (Excel SKEW, pandas .skew(); PerformanceAnalytics 'fisher')
